content.question: How do gradient boosting machines build their models?
options: Sequentially, by fitting each new model to the residual errors of the previous one - essentially gradient descent in function space.
In parallel, on independent bootstrap subsets of the data.
By majority voting among pre-trained decision trees.
By averaging the predictions of randomly initialized networks.
content.answer: Sequentially, by fitting each new model to the residual errors of the previous one - essentially gradient descent in function space.
